remarks: Looking for a renovated one level unit to live in the Cove neighborhood of Stamford? Look no further. This fully renovated open floor plan 2 bedroom, 2 bath unit features quartz kitchen countertops, stainless steel appliances (with dishwasher), in-unit laundry, and ample closet space. The primary bedroom features an ensuite bathroom and oversized walk-in closet. The second spacious bedroom features a large closet, and utilizes the 2nd bathroom. One off-street assigned parking space is included + visitor parking. Tenant is responsible for electricity, while trash and water are included. 2 months security, good credit, income verification, background check, and rental application are required. Schedule a tour before it's gone.
